fresh_closure.core_smoke: django.setup + migrate + bulk POST/upsert + collection/detail DELETE policy executed by the extracted wheel
fresh_closure.method: wheel payload extracted + exact mandatory closure symlinked from the prepared wheelhouse; no package manager runs
fresh_closure.test_build_tooling: 10 declared test/build-only distributions explicitly added to the gate environment (not to the runtime closure)

independent_gate.note: the E8 read-replica expectation (bulk POST succeeds) is superseded by the approved R5 early fail-closed contract; that case is covered by the product R5 suite instead

preserved.author_runtime_suite: 71-test runtime gate is green; the 45 historical tests are unchanged
preserved.filters: filterset_class and legacy filter_class paths green
preserved.recursive_field: real nested term/data-mart tree output green
preserved.rollback: apply-failure, real IntegrityError and late-hook rollback green
preserved.routers: real InfLabs router/nested router contract green

R1.contract: collection DELETE is authorized only by predicates the filterset declares and really applies; unknown/ignored/empty scope is refused; the ORM collector effect set equals the named leaves

R2.contract: nested URL parent/data-mart bounds POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE; a conflicting query scope is refused explicitly; a body parent_id/parent__slug cannot re-point the write (URL parent wins)

R3.contract: typed identity lookup, scoped target and whole-batch object permission run before the state-aware validators; forbidden and unknown identities are refused before validators; the admitted identity is the saved identity

R4.contract: collection and detail DELETE default-deny implicit MPTT/CASCADE effects (subtree, characteristics/marks, related data); per-object delete callbacks keep the batch atomic

R5.contract: one write alias for the whole admission/validation/atomic/save chain; models no longer open an implicit default-database transaction; divergent read/write routers are refused before validators and the first write; distributed atomicity is not claimed

R6.contract: E8 negatives live in the product regression gate as durable tests; no historical test rewritten; before/after state is captured before status assertions; wheel built outside the clone with a fresh mandatory-only closure under pipefail; failures/errors/skips fail the gate

scope: bounded R1-R6 safety repair over the frozen failed candidate; not a full runtime acceptance
unverified: No live database, deployment, restart, release or push was performed; all tests use synthetic SQLite in memory.
Optional auth/admin/search/task/geo extras are declared by the wheel but were not installed or verified for this pilot.
Distributed atomicity across databases is not claimed; write/replica divergence is refused, not synchronized.
The E9 gate is an offline artifact gate; independent E10.safetycheck acceptance and the human G1.safety decision are still pending.
Entity bulk POST/upsert shares the admission code path but has no new dedicated regression test; the entity endpoint is read-only by default in the synthetic harness.
The djangorestframework-filters 1.0.0.dev2 + django-filter 26.2 pin remains the accepted research matrix, not a maintained-support proof.

wheel.build: PEP 517 setuptools --no-isolation from a workspace copy outside the clone (includes the ignored prebuilt frontend bundle and normalised file modes); SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH fixed to 1792847103
wheel.install: no pip install (forbidden by the card); the wheel payload is extracted into a fresh venv site-packages and imported from there
